question: How many days of Privilege Leave (PL) does a permanent employee get per year?
answer:
Permanent employees are entitled to 12 days of Privilege Leave (PL) per calendar year (1st January – 31st December). Leave taken without manager approval will result in salary deduction.

Source: hr_manual.pdf, Page 60, Section: SECTION - IV - [G] Leave Policy

HR Manual - 60[G] Leave Policy
Meaning/Purpose
This policy encourages its employees to take a break from work as this provides healthy,stress free and more 
productive staff.
The leave policy sets out the various types of leaves that an employee is eligible for and outlines the procedure 
for taking leave.
 ԂLeave year is as per the calendar year (1st January – 31st December).
 ԂThe different types of leaves covered under this policy are :
 ¤Privilege Leave (PL) – 12 days
 ¤Casual Leave (CL) – 6 days
 ¤Sick Leave (SL) – 6 days
 ¤Stress Leave (STL) – 6 days
 ¤Maternity Leave (leeway)
 ԂThe policy is applicable for all permanent employees of ENSO GROUP and not for Contract employees.

question: What is the probation period for employees up to Senior Manager?
answer:
All employees up to Senior Manager are placed on probation for a period of 3 months from the date of their joining. Employees above Senior Manager are treated as confirmed from date of joining.

Source: hr_manual.pdf, Page 42, Section: SECTION - IV - [B] Probation Policy

How many days of maternity leave are given?
answer:
The company provides a total of 12 weeks (90 days) of Maternity Leave (ML) with pay for confirmed female staff who have worked for at least 80 days in the preceding 12 months, of which not more than 6 weeks (45 days) should precede expected delivery.

Source: hr_manual.pdf, Page 62, Section: SECTION - IV - [G] Leave Policy
